text:
Rae: Impromptu rooftop sunset toast + mini trivia this Friday? Thinking small charcuterie, sparkling sodas, and 15-min pub trivia rounds. low-key vibes. who wants in? :sparkler:
Sam: in! can bring bluetooth speaker and a battery pack. :musical_note:
Diego: Sounds great. I'll bring a couple of picnic blankets and my portable LED lanterns.
Ava: Love this. Quick Q: any allergy notes we should know before charcuterie? I'm allergic to tree nuts.
Ben: Good call @Ava. I'll do nut-free options and some gluten-free crackers.
Rae: Thanks @Ben. plan is simple: 6:30pm, 45-60 mins. If more people want to hang we can migrate to the lobby.
Sam: Also can run a 3-round trivia: general / sci-fi / company-memes. 2-person teams ok?
Diego: Teams of 2 max. I call dibs on pairing with @Sam :grin:
Ava: 2-person teams perfect. can I bring flashcards with prompts? low-tech vibes.
Rae: yes! we'll keep score on a sticky and hand out chocolate medals (or stickers). :chocolate_bar: :tada:
poll-bot: Poll created — Vote for snack preference: 1) Cheese-forward charcuterie 2) Veg-forward grazing board 3) Finger-food mix
Rae: react with :one::two::three: and add :wave: if you're bringing a guest.
Ben: :three: and no guest for me
Sam: :one: and bringing speaker. +1 maybe? :busts_in_silhouette:
Diego: :two: I prefer more veggies after last week's heavy lunch
Ava: :two: (allergy-friendly)
poll-bot: Current votes — Cheese(1), Veg(2), Finger(0). Veg-forward leading.
Rae: Veg-forward it is. @Ben thanks for handling GF + nut-free. I'll DM a shopping list later.
Sam: Quick logistics check: rooftop close time is 9pm right? we should be packed by 8:30 latest.
Diego: Facilities said quiet-hours start at 9, so we're good. I'll pack away lanterns and blankets by 8:25.
Rae: Perfect. I'll create calendar event now. working title: "Sunset Sips & Tiny Trivia"
calendar-bot: Event created: "Sunset Sips & Tiny Trivia" Fri 6:30pm — RSVP open
Ava: yay! can someone bring napkins and extra utensils? I'm short on disposables.
Ben: I'll bring napkins, plates, and a trash bag.
Sam: I'll queue up the trivia questions and a 3-song playlist.
Rae: You're the best. see you Friday :sun_with_face:
